order: Add continuous integration that runs the review-lane suite (`node tests/review-lane.test.js`) on Linux, Windows, and macOS across Node 20, 22 and 24, for every push and pull request. Windows is the reason this exists: every field failure in this lane has happened there, the suite exited 0 there even with failing cases, and no session working on this repo has a Windows machine to check by hand. Fix in the same change the two Windows facts the matrix forces open: the runner cannot CreateProcess a `.js` file, so the tests hand it a `.cmd` shim, and `kill('SIGTERM')` there is TerminateProcess, so the Windows expectation is the SIGKILL one. Every leg of the matrix must run to completion and report its own result; one red leg may never cancel or hide the others, since seeing WHICH platforms disagree is the entire point. No build, bundle or publish step, and no linter job or new dependency — plain node and plain git only.
claims: Order fulfilled as written. `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs `node tests/review-lane.test.js` on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest across Node 20/22/24, on push, pull_request and manual dispatch. Every matrix leg runs to completion and reports its own result, so one platform's failure cannot cancel or hide the others and a run always shows which platforms disagree. No build, bundle or publish step; no linter job and no new dependency — the job needs only plain node and plain git. The two Windows facts are handled in the suite: a `.cmd` shim for the stub, and the SIGKILL expectation asserted on Windows.
